_comment: spa_routes = SPA-owned page routes, matched EXACTLY (not by prefix). Plan 3 Task 9 flipped this from the temporary ['/app'] scaffold to ['/'] (the React dashboard now owns the root; the Jinja calls_index was retired). The root special-case in is_spa_route owns ONLY '/' — '/calls/1', '/api/x', '/made-up-page' all fall through to FastAPI's real 404. backend_prefixes lists the real top-level prefixes mounted in main.py (golden-set lives under /admin; rubric/sections/annotations/files/references/citations all live under /workspaces; there is no /events route yet). NOTE: backend_prefixes / is_backend_route are currently NOT consulted by the serving or proxy path — the Vite dev proxy is default-to-backend (it forwards everything to FastAPI except SPA routes + Vite assets, see frontend/src/dev-proxy.ts) and the prod catch-all keys off is_spa_route alone. They are retained as the documented prefix set and a future explicit-carve-out helper.
